verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (brand, headline, subhead, pills, CTA), but the pills sit jammed under the subhead and the CTA is centred while everything else is left-aligned at a tight ~30px margin, so the alignment is mixed. B breaks the reading order and grouping: the CTA floats on the right between the subhead and the pills, its right edge doesn't line up with the headline or the pill row, the pills are pushed below the action, and the two yellow circles sit heavily behind the headline.
